notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror launches March 28 on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9613608/11457eb25137af06de2ed55da314c8e9476677a6.jpg
Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror, the newest installment in the Dollhouse series, will officially launch on Steam on March 28, 2025! Prepare to join Eliza on a haunting journey through two nightmarish realities and uncover the twisted mystery of her broken mind. 

To celebrate, we’ve just unveiled a brand-new trailer, offering a glimpse into the immersive gameplay, unsettling challenges, and bone-chilling encounters that await in this psychological horror experience.

[previewyoutube=oIaeFDudFfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to add Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror to your wishlist today to stay updated on all the latest news and prepare yourself for the darkness ahead.

Thanks,
-SOEDESCO

Wishlist NOW
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791660/Dollhouse_Behind_the_Broken_Mirror/

notes.title: Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl is out now!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/e155a4be0d49c0a69d4f51ab850f42eaf682391d.jpg

 The highly competitive VR card-battler Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl is now available! 	

Friends turn foes as players step into Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl’s merciless VR battlegrounds. Unlock, collect and upgrade dozens of cards to build a powerful deck, and watch your cards come to life as you cast spells and summon forces to wipe your enemy off the map. Join a clan, take on opponents from around the globe in regular online tournaments, and claim your place on the global leaderboards. This is no friendly battle… this is war!

Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl is now available with a 15% discount in launch week only!  Visit the store page here.

See you on the battlegrounds!

notes.title: ADAM SWINGS INTO ACTION ONCE MORE WITH NEW TRAILER
notes.content:
ADAM’S VENTURE: ORIGINS GETS FIRST GAMEPLAY TRAILER


ROTTERDAM, THE NETHERLANDS(17-02-2016) – SOEDESCO has released the first full trailer for upcoming puzzle-adventure title Adam’s Venture: Origins. The trailer offers would-be adventurers their first look at the tasks awaiting them when the game hits PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC in early 2016.

Check out the trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uaIeman1_ZQ&feature=youtu.be

The adventure begins in 1928, when a routine excavation of a French church leads to the discovery of a strange scroll bearing Templar symbols. What follows is a race to uncover the location of the four rivers mentioned in the Book of Genesis – and unpick what this could mean.

The trailer below reveals some of the challenges Adam will have to overcome, from careering through a bat-infested cave in a runaway mine cart, to navigating perilous ruins in a wide-range of countries. A selection of the game’s fiendishly challenging puzzles are also showcased – check them out here along with some new screenshots:
 
WHAT IS ADAM’S VENTURE: ORIGINS?

Adam’s Venture: Origins was first announced last year. Set in the 1920’s, Adam’s Venture Origins is an extensive remake of the originally announced game, reimagining the franchise as a fully formed non-violent, next generation adventure game. The game is streamlined and replotted to forge an engaging narrative that plays out across a single game experience.

Using Unity 5, Adam’s Venture: Origins features enhanced, next-gen visuals, new gameplay, and new animation work to make this into a much improved and engaging experience. Combined with challenging puzzles, stunning visuals, engaging narrative and tight gameplay, Adam’s Venture: Origins is set to mark the fulfillment of the original vision of developer Vertigo Games.

A release date for the game is set to be revealed shortly.
